recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中央有一顆大型細胞，細胞質極多、淡紫而邊界模糊呈網狀，偏心的腎形核染色質細緻，周圍是體積小很多的造血細胞，是正常骨髓中的組織球（histiocyte）；照片略失焦。
features: Large cell many times the size of surrounding hematopoietic cells
Abundant pale lilac, lacy cytoplasm with indistinct, irregular borders
Single oval to reniform nucleus with fine, slightly vesicular chromatin; nucleolus not clearly seen
No obvious phagocytosed cells, hemosiderin or crystalline inclusions visible at this focus
Surrounding normal erythroid and granulocytic precursors; image slightly out of focus
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant pale, lacy cytoplasm and ill-defined borders containing a single oval to reniform nucleus with fine chromatin. No phagocytosed cells, pigment or abnormal inclusions are evident, though the image is slightly out of focus, limiting fine detail. The surrounding erythroid and granulocytic precursors appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a benign resident histiocyte in normal bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have abundant cytoplasm with a striated crumpled tissue-paper texture and are often multiple, unlike this pale lacy cytoplasm.
Osteoblasts have an eccentric round nucleus with a perinuclear pale Golgi zone set away from the nucleus in basophilic cytoplasm, often in clusters.
Megakaryocytes have multilobated large nuclei with granular pink cytoplasm, whereas this cell has a single reniform nucleus.
Tumor cells occur in cohesive clusters with nuclear atypia and prominent nucleoli, unlike this solitary bland cell.
